Zoe: noted GF. Plan: start 18:30, casual warmups, 20:00 friendly Rocket League tourney. Bring chargers.
Max: Can someone make a tiny poll? Reaction :one: RL tourney, :two: coop night, :three: party games.
Rex: :two:
Ivy: :one:
Zoe: mixed schedule then. calendar-bot: can you make an event?
